in_marathi.name: Nabarun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nabarun हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nabarun is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Nabha' (night) and 'Runa' (runner). This name is associated with the Hindu deity Krishna, who is often depicted as the 'Nabhavasanta Raja' (King of the Night).
